description: This file defines types and functions for handling reasoning details and converting message formats between Anthropic and OpenAI, with special handling for Gemini models and reasoning tokens.

methods.name: consolidateReasoningDetails
methods.description: Consolidates an array of reasoning details by grouping by index and type, filtering out corrupted encrypted blocks, concatenating text and summaries, and keeping only the last encrypted data per index.

methods.name: sanitizeGeminiMessages
methods.description: Filters reasoning details in messages to only include entries matching tool call IDs for Gemini models, removing mismatched reasoning details and associated tool calls.

methods.name: convertToOpenAiMessages
methods.description: Converts Anthropic messages into OpenAI chat message format, handling reasoning details, tool use, images, and merging text content based on options.
